name: OGX.JS application
description: How to build an OGX.JS app. OML describes the nodes of one route. The application around that OML is app.json, stage and view classes, HTML templates, and index.html.

files: www/index.html loads CSS, OGX.JS, then each controller, view, and stage, then www/js/bin/index.js
www/app.json is loaded by new OGX.App. The file name is app.json and it lives in www.
www/html/template.Name.html is a preloaded HTML template
www/css/stages/stage.Name.css and www/css/views/view.Name.css are linked beside the matching script
www/oml/name.oml and www/json/name.json are preloaded files a route can name

boot.test_app: The OGX_JS_TEST app waits for deviceready when cordova exists, then document ready, then app = new OGX.App({encrypted: 'wasm'}). A page with no cordova calls the same constructor from document ready.
boot.body: index.html has an empty body. The stage template supplies the element that receives views.

order: each view script followed by its css
each stage script followed by its css

routing.index: Stage selector plus path, such as main/home. Used when the URL has no hash.
routing.routes: Each key is a path. The first segment is the vapp selector.

app_json.vapps: Each key is selector:Stages.Name. The selector becomes the stage id and the first segment of its routes.

vapp_fields.template: Template name for the stage HTML.
vapp_fields.placeholder: Selector inside that template where the route OML is attached. The test app uses #view.
vapp_fields.anim: false, or swap, or flip, when changing stage.

defaults.stage: Merged into every vapp. Built-in keys are always_on, blured, closeable, and anim.
defaults.popup: Merged into every popup. The test app sets width, height, and anim here.
defaults.window: Merged into every window. The test app sets head, width, and icons here.
defaults.overlay: Built-in keys are delay and anim.

app_json.preload: Keys are folders under www, with a leading slash. Values are file names. /html lists template.Name.html. /oml lists name.oml. /json lists name.json.
app_json.jwt: false in the test app. true makes OGX.Scope read the scope from a JWT.

methods.construct: Called after the view is built. The test app receives __data and __route_data.
methods.ux: Called with true when the view focuses and false when it blurs.
methods.onResize: Called when the view size changes.
methods.destroy: Called when the view is destroyed. OGX nodes do not need to be destroyed here.

view.lookup: A view reaches a child with this.children('Timeband')[0]. A controller reaches a node in the cache with app.cfind('DynamicList', 'list'). find walks down from the node it is called on. cfind reads the global cache.

controller.oml: Put the controller beside the view in the route, as ctrl:Controllers.Home with an empty config.

route.file: A string names a preloaded oml file. "oml": "flip" uses www/oml/flip.oml after /oml lists flip.oml.
route.capture: A path such as main/item/(title:[a-zA-Z0-9]+) captures groups. data:OSE {{%}} passes the captured object. A query string is also available as {{%}}.
route.options: A route may set options.history. Cache for one route is the cache field, in seconds, 0 to keep it, and it requires routing.options.cache.

oml.shape: One JSON object. Each key is selector:Class. The value is that class config. Child nodes go under node:OML as an object or an array of objects.
selectors: default:Class attaches to the element the class creates
default .list:DynamicList is the default element, then .list
main:Stages.Main is a vapp key, not the root of a route
default:Templates.Home is a preloaded HTML template
popupId:Popup and windowId:Window are floats. The selector is the id
oml.template_name: The file is template.Home.html. The OML value is Home.

point.as_property: A view may set point to the same range object. A range value can be an OML node that moves an existing node. target and parent accept lookup and lookdown queries, as in {"lookup": {"id": "main"}, "lookdown": {"name": "home"}}.

ose.{{$title}}: In an HTML template, a property of the view data object.
ose.{{%}}: The route capture or query-string object.
ose.{{$}}: The current data object. comment.oml passes it with data:OSE.

navigation.same_url: Pass reload true to open the current URL again.
navigation.link: Home calls the same navigation. Internal links start with /stage/route.
navigation.current: app.getURL() returns the URL of the stage in use.

popup_from_code: A view may call app.addPopup with id, title, width, height, anim, node:OML, and buttons. defaults.popup is merged into that config. Popup and Window field lists are in oml://attributes.
also_read: oml://attributes lists OML config keys for the core components.
oml://ose lists the scripting language used in templates and in keys that end with :OSE.

cli.init: ogx init creates the www folders.
cli.rename: ogx rename view MyView MyNewName also updates app.json.

custom_component.runtime: From a view, this.create('MyComponent', {el: '#my_element', id: 'whatever'}). Children created in node:OML are read with this.children.
custom_component.name: Do not reuse a class name the catalog already lists.

size.description: Window width and other sizes accept a size expression. OGX.Data.getBestSize picks a value that fits the parent.
size.plus: The trailing + picks the largest candidate that still fits.
size.minus: The trailing - picks the smallest candidate.
size.limits: [100,400] keeps the chosen size inside the range. [=100,=400] snaps to those hard limits. [100] is a minimum.

scope.app_json: scope on the app and on a vapp is public in the test app. jwt true makes OGX.Scope read the token.
scope.token: OGX.Scope.token(token, issuer). From 1.57.0 the issuer defaults to the main label of the hostname and can be passed once.
scope.eval: OGX.Scope.eval('admin|manager', entity.scope) is true when either scope is present. support+csuite requires both. A /regex/ is also an expression.
scope.node: A string scope on a node must match. An array scope is the older loose form.

rules: Read this document, then attributes, ose, specification, components, and examples, before writing an app.
Do not make Stage or App the root of a route. Declare the stage in vapps and put selector:Views.Name in the route.
Every Views, Stages, and Controllers class needs a require() line and a construct() call whose string matches the class name.
List every template, oml, and json file in preload before a route names it.
The placeholder selector must exist in the stage template.
Method names from read_runtime are not keys in app.json or in OML.
The router option that closes a popup on history back is hide_popup.
